connector.name: Source Parts
connector.registryDescription: Electronic component sourcing, BOM management, and PCB design workflows.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.source.parts over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package parts-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sourceparts account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
